Biton says he agreed not to report on the practice after senior defense officials told him not to. He accuses the reporters who exposed it of seeking only applause, and says the procedure could have continued to be used in Syria, Lebanon and other places where Israel might invade in the future. His words echo those of Israeli soldiers who revealed the procedure and said they prefer that kidnapped Palestinian civilians used as bait die instead of Israeli soldiers.
